statement: Cinema XXI (Q1 2025 results): 'Pada bulan Maret 2025, bertepatan dengan momen Ramadhan, kami mencatat penurunan aktivitas menonton film di bioskop jika dibandingkan dengan hari-hari biasa, karena adanya perubahan tren konsumsi masyarakat.' Q1 2025 had 5 films above 1 juta penonton vs 7 in Q1 2024.
number: Q1 2025 revenue Rp 929,2 miliar; no % given for Ramadan drop

statement: Cinema XXI: 'Di bulan April 2025, jumlah penonton sudah mendekati total penonton pada kuartal pertama 2025. Lonjakan ini datang dari lima film yang tayang selama libur Lebaran.'
number: April 2025 admissions about equal to all of Jan-Mar 2025 (roughly 3x a normal month)

statement: Cinema XXI H1 2023: Q2 2023 viewership up 74% vs Q1 2023 (revenue +74.9%); 'Banyak masyarakat pergi ke bioskop karena bersamaan dengan masa liburan Hari Raya Idulfitri 1444 H dan libur sekolah.'
period_referred: Q2 2023 (Lebaran 22 Apr 2023 plus school holidays) vs Q1 2023 (incl. start of Ramadan 23 Mar 2023)

statement: Exhuma (Korean film, released 28 Feb 2024) kept roughly 100 ribu penonton per day; peak about 200 ribu on 11 Mar 2024 (Nyepi, eve of Ramadan); went from 1 juta (10 Mar) to 2 juta (21 Mar) during the first 10 days of Ramadan 2024.
number: about 90-100k per day before and during early Ramadan

statement: Kompas (Cinepoint data as of 14 Apr 2025): Pabrik Gula 'mulai kehilangan banyak layarnya' in week 2 while Jumbo gained screens; Pabrik Gula daily trend declining after peak on 2 Apr (CNN 10 Apr).
number: Pabrik Gula 4,028,427 vs Jumbo 3,528,792 on 14 Apr

statement: Suara/Cinepoint screen counts on day 3 of Lebaran 2025 (2 Apr): Pabrik Gula 3,225 screens (+19.53%), Qodrat 2 1,806 (-2.48%), Jumbo 1,706 (-1.56%), Komang 1,561 (-11.91%), Norma 933 (-19.50%).
number: screen shares shift fast: winner +20%, weakest -20% by day 3

statement: Tabloidbintang on 2nd Miracle in Cell No.7 and Panggonan Wingit 2 (both opened 25 Dec 2024): extra screens added on day 2; 'Apalagi musim liburan Nataru masih panjang' (long holiday season supports legs).
number: 2nd Miracle about 140k per day average over first 4 days

statement: Moana 2 dominance hurt local films in Dec 2024: 'Larisnya film Moana 2 berdampak pada film-film Indonesia, yang dalam tiga minggu terakhir, kecuali Bila Esok Ibu Tiada, sepi penonton'; 4 local films opened 5 Dec and none reached 50 ribu (later: none reached 60 ribu in 4 days).
number: Moana 2 week 2 'hampir 1 juta'; Sunday 8 Dec 200 ribu+

statement: Racun Sangga (opened 12 Dec 2024) second Sunday (22 Dec) drew 'kurang dari 23 ribu' vs 54,421 on its first Sunday, as new Christmas releases (Sorop, Modal Nekad, Mufasa on 18-19 Dec) took screens; article cites shrinking screens and showtimes.
Bila Esok Ibu Tiada (opened 14 Nov 2024) added only 25 ribu lebih in the 7 days to hari ke-49 (about 3,571 per day) over the New Year week; already pulled from Jabodetabek screens.

Tabloidbintang: 'Film Indonesia rilisan Maret kurang mendapat respons dari masyarakat. Hingga pekan ke-3, baru satu film dari sembilan film yang telah edar, yang berhasil lampaui 100 ribu penonton' (Singsot 112,870 after 7 days; Setan Botak 60k+, Desa Mati 55k+ after about 2 weeks).
number: 1 of 9 March 2025 releases above 100k by week 3

statement: Opening days during Ramadan 2025 were tiny: five local films opening Thu 13 Mar, best was Singsot with 10,265 on day 1 ('Ngenes ... terbanyak hanya 10 ribu'); four horror films opening Thu 6 Mar, best Setan Botak 22,893.
number: day-1 best 10k to 23k vs 60k to 200k for Lebaran openers

statement: Holdover decay into Ramadan 2025: Petaka Gunung Gede (opened 6 Feb) added about 167k/day mid-Feb, 32k/day around 27 Feb-3 Mar, about 27k/day 4-5 Mar, about 18.5k/day 6-13 Mar and about 14k/day 17-23 Mar, with about 250 cinemas left by 7 Mar.
number: daily adds fell roughly 50% per week through Ramadan

statement: Iblis Dalam Kandungan 2 (opened 27 Feb 2025, run inside Ramadan): 100k by day 4, then 'hampir 10 ribu dalam 2 hari terakhir (Sabtu dan Minggu)' on 8-9 Mar and '+21 ribu dalam 7 hari' to 24 Mar.
number: weekend days about 5k vs opening-weekend about 30k; week 4 about 3k/day

statement: Agak Laen (opened 1 Feb 2024): 'Jika sebelumnya dalam sehari bisa meraup 500 ribu penonton, namun dalam 6 haru terakhir hanya 70 ribu perhari' (to 9 Mar 2024, just before Ramadan 2024).

1 Kakak 7 Ponakan (opened 23 Jan 2025) grew in days 4-7 thanks to the Isra Miraj (27 Jan) and Imlek (28-29 Jan) long weekend: daily 73,739 (day 4), 100,497 (day 5), 95,303 (day 6), 83k (day 7); producer: 'Liburan makin rame'.
number: holiday weekdays exceeded the opening Sunday by about 35%
